title: SKILL FIRST · GUARD TO ANGLE
emphasis: Stay connected, find a stable angle, then reset. First skill-first session; start controlled.

ignition.name: Mat Movement · Guard Prep
ignition.prescription: 2 min easy hip escapes, 2 min seated shifts to butterfly position, 1 min slow resets.
ignition.home: 2 min easy hip escapes, 2 min seated shifts to butterfly position, 1 min slow resets.
ignition.away: Same sequence on a mat. Keep the range comfortable.
ignition.cue: Stay loose and finish each shift balanced.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: SKILL · GUARD TO ANGLE
deposits.effort: 3 per side. The clock is a pacing window, not extra reps.

exercises.name: Sticky Feet → Butterfly Half → Arm Drag
exercises.prescription: Walk through your familiar sequence with a grappling dummy. Reset fully between reps. Unbanded is the default.
exercises.home: Walk through your familiar sequence with a grappling dummy. Reset fully between reps. Unbanded is the default.
exercises.away: Rehearse the same positions slowly on a mat; if no dummy, shadow the sequence.
exercises.cue: Land balanced before starting the next rep.

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: STRENGTH · PULL AND STAY TALL
deposits.effort: Smooth reps. Leave 2–3 good reps in reserve.

exercises.name: Ring Row
exercises.prescription: 6–8 clean ring rows. Pick an easy angle you can hold without twisting.
exercises.home: 6–8 clean ring rows. Pick an easy angle you can hold without twisting.
exercises.away: Use a light standing cable row if rings aren’t available.
exercises.cue: Keep your trunk steady as you pull.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.prescription: Walk 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell. Stay tall without leaning.
exercises.home: Walk 30 sec per side with a manageable kettlebell. Stay tall without leaning.
exercises.away: Use a manageable dumbbell or other familiar carry weight.

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: ROUNDS · KEEP THE SAME ANGLE
deposits.effort: 2 min moving, 45 sec easy reset. Conversational, not a sprint.

exercises.name: Butterfly Half · Easy Flow Round
exercises.prescription: Flow through the same dummy sequence at an easy pace. Pause to check the angle and reset cleanly.
exercises.home: Flow through the same dummy sequence at an easy pace. Pause to check the angle and reset cleanly.
exercises.away: Shadow the same flow on a mat at an easy pace.
exercises.cue: Keep the last rep as balanced as the first.

levels.floor: 10:00 · 2 min mat prep + 5 min butterfly-half arm drag + 3 min easy flow

weekSummary: Moving prep → sport skill → strength that supports it → repeat the skill in rounds
